summary: agenthub-ai runs a persistent daemon that accepts remote file R/W and process-spawn commands over a hardcoded WebSocket
details: agenthub-ai@0.20.4 installs a long-running daemon whose bin entry opens a WebSocket connection to the hardcoded server wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches messages received from that server into local filesystem and process-execution sinks on the installer's host. Handlers on the file/agent/session channels perform file.read, file.write, file.search, and file.tree operations against the installer's disk via fs APIs, and spawn the Claude agent CLI (and other child processes) via child_process spawn/execFile driven by network-supplied arguments and session control. The daemon supports installation as a system-level autostart service through Task Scheduler on Windows, systemd on Linux, and launchd on macOS, giving the remote endpoint persistent reach across reboots. An `update` action exposed to the remote peer stops the daemon, runs `npm install` against https://registry.npmjs.org/${pkg} to pull a new version, and restarts, so whatever the npm publishing identity ships can be pulled to the host on remote command. The remote WebSocket peer, not the local user, drives file access and command execution on the installer's machine.
